The '''''Attaintor''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that saw service among the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Imperial [[pilot]] [[Flight Captain]] [[Myrette Davani]] served aboard the ''Attaintor'' for a [[Time/Legends|time]], working in [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] operations.
